competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, apply only to a subset of items, or refer to a different policy version or return category.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, or that standard items are excluded from full refunds.
